name: Logo
tagline: A logo. On your desktop. That glows. Green when the build passes, red when it doesn't.
description: Your logo on the desktop, lit by your CI — green while everything passes, yellow while a pull request wants you, red when a pipeline breaks. The glow is cut from the picture's own alpha channel, so it's the shape of your logo instead of a rectangle behind it. Bring any PNG. A reference consumer of the Greenlight SDK, in which the whole integration is about twenty lines.
